The conduit band is structure-class above the rooflines (NeonAntenna r87 exempt precedent), capped under the tint band top 14 and clear of the far-shore strip (y 14.26..14.74).
law.zero_move: v0.1 places 1 pod + the conduit with ZERO seat/robot/vehicle/sign/eave-slot moves (r111 law). Seat or fixture moves are a CEO-visible trade, never a silent default (r137 quota-ledger law) - the remedy candidates below are registered options, none exercised (and the ResN01 path is probe-proven DEAD: the seat is cage-locked).

law.glass_door_debt: the glass-pod vocabulary carries no street door (r136 door-census family). Registered open debt like the v1 five-office door debt (terraces verdict) - CEO sees it at the pin-formation re-review.
law.honest_states: statics only this round. The incubator pod sits dormant (low-glass sleep) until BigDomain Phase 1 lights real incubation tasks - no fake running animation (decoration ban). Birth wall / sandbox exhibits wire with the M2 state round; the statics never bake dead numbers (stale honesty law).
law.pipe_band: elevated conduit band y 13.0..13.6667: west end flush at the brain-tower east face x=3.0 (B7 dock), east end flush at the pod east face x=23.0; the stub (pipe-v) mounts the pod roof (host-mount, sign-mounting precedent: sinks 0.3333 into the pod top) and ties the band down to the pod.
law.pipe_crossing: the conduit crosses the east avenue road cells (cols 17/18) ONLY inside the elevated band y >= 13.0 (box-on-ledge row-8 props precedent for structure-on-road); buildings and stand cells still never touch road cells.
law.zone_disjointness: conduit band y 13.0..13.6667 stays disjoint from the COMMIT cross-river data stream (river band Y -4.6..+4.6) and the TRANSFER trunk street band (y -7.5) - geometry domains never overlap (r114/territory law, asserted in the sandbox gate).
law.superbody_blue: baked r140: CPH4 64,196,255 main anchor (brain-tower research color family), five-color law untouched.
law.t2_six_types: schema/events-registry.json carries the six labs types this round in reserved state (first-register law, veto window to 2026-10-02, P-2026-09-24-39): LAB_INCUBATE_START/PASS/FAIL + RESIDENT_BIRTH + PROPOSAL_NEW/APPLIED - emitters land with the M2 wire round.
